summary: launchpad makes your Cloudflare site itself, calls your app by its real name, and fixes iPhone and Android snags.
notes: Storing a key no longer asks you to make up a passphrase on Windows or Linux. launchpad makes its own key for its vault.
For a static site, launchpad creates the Cloudflare Pages project with your token, and your first push publishes the site.
Your app shows up under its real name, from its page title, its Xcode project or its Android app name, instead of a folder called app.
iPhone apps: the app ID you pick is written into your Xcode project, and a release no longer runs Swift package tests that only build for iPhone.
Android: adding a tester finds the Firebase key you stored for that app, and the build check picks the right pnpm version for your repo.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
